summary.headline: Division of Revolutions
summary.text: Chapter VII divides revolutions into planetary conjunctions and eclipses, and yearly world revolutions judged from the Sun’s entry into Aries, the lord of the year, planetary aspects, latitude, rising, setting, direction, retrogradation, and fixed stars. Authorities and sources include Geber, Albumasar, Messahallah’s Epistle, John of Seville, Djabir ben Aflah, Albertus, and Steinschneider.
